en.headline: Extremely hot weather continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and extremely hot conditions on Tuesday, with some areas reaching 37 degrees Celsius or above under residual influence from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said Tropical Cyclone Dolphin’s outer subsiding air would continue to bring extremely hot weather to Hong Kong on Tuesday, with the Very Hot Weather Warning remaining in force.
Temperatures in urban areas are forecast to reach around 35 degrees Celsius, while some New Territories districts could hit 37 degrees or higher. Isolated showers may appear later in the day.

The Observatory advised the public to take heatstroke precautions, drink plenty of water, avoid prolonged outdoor activities and seek medical help if symptoms such as dizziness or nausea develop. High temperatures are expected to ease gradually from midweek as a southwesterly airstream takes over.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 今日繼續極端酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台料熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響下，星期二大致天晴極端酷熱，部分地區氣溫達37度或以上。
body: 香港天文台表示，熱帶氣旋白海豚的外圍下沉氣流繼續影響本港，酷熱天氣警告於星期二仍然生效。
預料市區最高氣溫約35度，新界部分地區可達37度或以上，稍後局部地區或有驟雨。
天文台呼籲市民留意身體健康狀況，多補充水分及做足防暑措施，避免戶外劇烈運動。若出現頭暈、頭痛、噁心等徵狀，應立刻休息並盡快求醫。隨後一兩日受西南氣流影響，高溫天氣將略為緩解。
